entries.report.title: Settlement report: did the node come through on its inference deals?
entries.report.summary: What this node's own sealed records show about how its paid inference deals settled. Each row is one term the node accepted, with its claims counted by verdict.
entries.group.come_through.title: Did the node come through on the terms it accepted?
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.label: Paid as agreed
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.detail: When the node bought: every invoice it saw has a settlement its own wallet reported, for the invoice's amount.
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.not_eval: The node's records do not show enough to say whether it paid as agreed.
entries.row.come_through.served_as_agreed.label: Settlement recorded for what it served
entries.row.come_through.served_as_agreed.detail: When the node provided: it served the exchange it accepted terms for, and every invoice it issued has a settlement its wallet reported, for the invoice's amount. The quality of the answer is not checked.
entries.row.come_through.served_as_agreed.not_ev: The node's records do not show enough to say whether a settlement was recorded for what it served.
entries.row.come_through.served_named_model.labe: Model it reported matches the model it named (its own report)
entries.row.come_through.served_named_model.deta: When the node provided: the model that answered is the model it named. Unless a referee already decided the deal, this is the node's own report of both, which no one else has checked.
entries.row.come_through.served_named_model.not_: The node's records do not show enough to say which model answered.
entries.verdict.out_of_scope: Did not apply to this deal
